title: MTCSTW.com Site Guide
author: MTCSTW / The Propaganda Factory
text:
MTCSTW.com is the home of The Propaganda Factory — a leftist creator network and action hub.

KEY PAGES:
- / (My HQ): The user dashboard. XP, ranks, Daily Orders, calendar, activity feed. This is the homepage.
- /karl: Chat with Karl, the AI revolutionary companion.
- /sick-left-radicals: The 62-affiliate creator roster with propaganda scores.
- /dossier: Build a dossier on a billionaire or corporation.
- /town: The town square — community organizing space.
- /town-report: File a field report from organizing work.
- /receipt: Upload receipts (price data for People's CPI, action evidence).
- /remix: Remix propaganda — create shareable content.
- /war-room: Strategy and campaign planning.
- /extraction: Data and intelligence tools.

USER SYSTEMS:
- Call signs: Every user claims a revolutionary callsign (one-time, permanent).
- XP & Ranks: Earn XP through actions. Ranks: SYMPATHIZER (0) → AGITATOR (250) → ORGANIZER (750) → CADRE (2000) → VANGUARD (5000) → COMMANDER (12000) → LEGEND (25000).
- Daily Orders: 30 rotating social missions. Complete them, report back, earn XP and streaks.
- Service Medals: Weekly medals for each game. Full set = FULL DEPLOYMENT (+50 XP).
- War Bonds: Support the network (grants 0 XP — money is delinked from XP).
- People's CPI: Crowdsourced price tracking — the people's inflation index.
- Fan Vote: Vote for Propagandist of the Week (Monday-Sunday, one vote per browser).

title: Site Games and Features Guide
author: MTCSTW / The Propaganda Factory
text:
MTCSTW.com features games that turn engagement into movement action.

DAILY ORDERS: 30 rotating social missions (share posts, recruit, document prices, etc.).
Report back to earn +15 XP and build streaks. New missions daily.

DO METER: Track your daily action output.

FAN VOTE: Vote for your favorite SLR creator each week. Winner announced Monday as FAN FAVORITE.

CREATOR XP (Agitator's Ledger): For creators — log actions, earn XP, climb from SYMPATHIZER to VANGUARD.
Actions: check-in (5 XP), post (10 XP), 10K views (25 XP), 100K views (100 XP), campaign deliverable (50 XP), recruit (75 XP).

TEAM LEADERBOARD: Weekly XP ranking for Creator HQ members.

PROPAGANDA QUIZ (Find Your SLR Match): 5 questions → your propaganda archetype + 3 creator matches.

PEOPLE'S CPI: Submit prices you pay. The network aggregates them into a people's inflation index.
This is proprietary movement data — transparent, aggregated, never sold.

WAR BONDS: $5-$50. 50% to network, 50% split equally among all roster creators.
Weekly team-board winner gets extra 5% from network's half.

All games feed the XP economy. XP unlocks ranks. Ranks unlock respect.
